title: Marvel Television’s ‘VisionQuest’ Ends on a Series High
summary: The 'VisionQuest' finale drew the biggest Marvel finale viewership in over 3 years, and helped boost 'Avengers: Doomsday' ticket sales.
body_markdown:
# Marvel Television’s ‘VisionQuest’ Ends on a Series High


[Entertainment](https://thewaltdisneycompany.com/entertainment/)


November 13, 2026


2 min. read


Excitement is building across the MCU, with this week’s


[VisionQuest](https://www.disneyplus.com/browse/entity-8744ec55-8d14-4631-99b4-c889a2d6013f) finale delivering


**the biggest Marvel finale audience in more than three years** and helping fuel a spike in ticket sales for


[Marvel Studios’ Avengers: Doomsday](https://www.marvel.com/movies/avengers-doomsday) .


The finale drew


**3.7 million views globally on Disney+** after its first day of streaming, a


**series high** and a


**44% jump** from the previous episode. It was the most-watched Marvel finale since


[Loki](https://www.disneyplus.com/browse/entity-8f8c5cbb-e5ba-4285-9e2c-86abcac9fd50) Season 2.


Marvel Television’s


*VisionQuest* has also landed on Nielsen’s Top 10 Streaming Originals chart for two consecutive weeks, moving from No. 7 to


**No. 6 in the latest rankings** *.


The series brings


**Paul Bettany** ’s Vision full circle in


[a story about identity and self-discovery](https://thewaltdisneycompany.com/news/marvel-television-visionquest-disney-plus/) , concluding the trilogy that began with


[WandaVision](https://www.disneyplus.com/browse/entity-90affd1f-0851-48bc-9cab-c142d5c9c20c) and continued with


[Agatha All Along](https://www.disneyplus.com/browse/entity-5e474669-a4a2-4b90-a928-5ae7f845090c) . It also marked the long-awaited return of


**James Spader** ’s Ultron, whose previous onscreen appearance came in 2015’s


[Avengers: Age of Ultron](https://www.disneyplus.com/browse/entity-42329b99-0953-4f1a-9420-a0dbf7733e95) .


## Marvel Television


### 'VisionQuest'


With a bounty on his head, Vision must confront his nature and resist Ultron’s influence to survive.


2026[Watch on Disney+](https://www.disneyplus.com/browse/entity-8744ec55-8d14-4631-99b4-c889a2d6013f)


That renewed connection to the Avengers is carrying beyond Disney+. Following


[the VisionQuest finale](https://www.marvel.com/articles/tv-shows/visionquest-finale-terry-matalas-interview) , the studio saw a spike in


*Avengers: Doomsday* ticket sales ahead of the film’s


**December 18 theatrical debut** .


The surge comes during a milestone year for Earth’s Mightiest Heroes.


*Avengers: Endgame* recently


[returned to the top of the worldwide box office rankings](https://thewaltdisneycompany.com/news/avengers-endgame-box-office-record/) , surpassing


[Avatar](https://www.disneyplus.com/browse/entity-357d8505-b9bc-41e3-9f27-0414738df143) to become the highest-grossing film in history with an estimated


**$2.9 billion globally** .


When


*Avengers: Doomsday* hits theaters,


[beloved heroes from three distinct universes](https://www.disneyplus.com/explore/articles/avengers-doomsday-cast-characters) will be set on a deadly collision course.
